g.text: ai-aware-konsole
Konsole fork whose tab turns yellow while an AI agent runs in that tab.
Entry points
State
Core · watcher
External
cmake -S src -B build → install to dot-local/bin/konsole
DetachableTabBar · one tab per session, title area is the only UI touched
viewFocusChangeHandler · refreshes on focus change, alongside the timer
konsolerc, group AgentDetection · enabled switch, tab colour, process-name list
proc/pid/stat + cmdline
Session::color + tab data variant
isTabColorSetByUser · a colour picked in Rename Tab is never overridden
profile tabColor · the value restored when the agent leaves
SessionController · owns _agentWatchTimer at 1000 ms (README still says 2 s) plus one shot at 0
Session::foregroundProcessGroupId · tcgetpgrp on the tab pty, -1 when unavailable
isAgentInProcessGroup · walks the procfs root, keeps pids whose stat field 3 equals the pgid
processMatchesAgent · comm substring rule first, then cmdline heuristics
name matcher · comm must match exactly, cmdline only for names longer than 3 chars, plus an agent carve-out for cursor's MainThread comm
updateAgentTabColor · sets session and controller colour only when it differs
paintEvent · fills each tabRect with the tab colour variant at alpha 235, then paints
kernel · pty foreground process group + live procfs table
agent processes · claude, opencode, codex, pi, agy, and their node or npx wrappers
KDE Konsole v25.12.3 · upstream tree vendored in the gitignored src
tmux and screen · they own the pty foreground group, so nested agents stay invisible
Qt 6.10 + KF6 6.24 · the stack the patch was verified against on Ubuntu 26.04
tab + 1 s tick + settings
colour writes · proc reads
scans pids · needs the pty pgid
